claim: One click opens a populated sample handoff without reading or changing real handoff data
where: landing action, demo workspace, README, privacy
sandbox: 390×844 fresh browser; seed a real record, enter /?demo=1, assert sample names and action are in view, then verify real and demo databases stay separate

claim: Reset demo clears demo activity and restores the shipped sample
sandbox: fresh demo; create a handoff, reset, assert empty demo log and restored sample fields

claim: Start for real discards the demo handoff log before leaving
sandbox: fresh demo; create a handoff, leave, return, and assert the demo log is empty

claim: Creates an AES-256 protected ZIP in the browser
sandbox: fresh demo; create and download the ZIP, assert every entry is WinZip AES with strength 3, prove missing and wrong phrases fail, then decrypt with the sample phrase

claim: ZIP entry names remain visible before the access phrase is entered
sandbox: fresh demo; download the protected ZIP, list both entry names without supplying a phrase, and do not decrypt their contents

claim: The handoff sheet names compatible extractors and tells the recipient what to report if opening fails
where: compatibility note, handoff sheet, terms, README
sandbox: fresh demo; download the handoff sheet and assert 7-Zip, Keka, PeaZip, supported platforms, and the device-and-app fallback

claim: The tool does not verify a recipient before creating a handoff
sandbox: fresh real mode; use an arbitrary first name, assert there is no account or identity field, record requests, and create the handoff without a verification step

claim: Works offline after the first visit
sandbox: fresh demo; wait for service worker control, go offline, reload, and create the sample handoff

claim: The handoff sheet names the downloaded ZIP and separates its route from the access-phrase route
sandbox: fresh demo; create and download both outputs, assert matching ZIP name and both delivery instructions

claim: The local handoff log stores only the recipient, dates, and selected routes
sandbox: fresh demo; create a handoff and inspect every IndexedDB field and value

claim: Exports the handoff log as JSON
sandbox: fresh demo; create a handoff, export JSON, and inspect its row fields

claim: Imports a valid handoff-log JSON export
sandbox: fresh demo; export a created handoff, reset the database, import the file, and assert the restored row

claim: Deletes a handoff-log entry after reload
sandbox: fresh demo; create a handoff, reload, confirm deletion, and assert the entry is absent from the visible log and IndexedDB

claim: Clearing this site's browser storage removes handoff records and saved license results
sandbox: fresh browser; create real and demo records plus license state, clear all browser site data for the origin, then assert no databases or license keys remain

claim: The ZIP access phrase is never stored or included in the handoff sheet
sandbox: fresh demo; create a handoff, inspect the downloaded sheet and IndexedDB records for the known sample phrase

claim: The core flow does not upload selected files, access phrases, file names, or handoff sheets
sandbox: fresh demo; record every request through creation, both downloads, and reset; assert only same-origin or blob requests

claim: Creating the ZIP, handoff sheet, handoff log, and exports remains free
where: first screen, Pro section, terms, README
sandbox: fresh real mode without a license; create a handoff and assert both downloads, log, and export are enabled

claim: Pro is offered for US $9 as a one-time purchase
where: first screen, Pro section, terms, README
sandbox: fresh real mode; assert the stated price and exact product checkout URL

claim: A verified Pro license adds a personal note to the downloaded handoff sheet
sandbox: fresh real mode with a recorded valid verdict; add a note, create the handoff, and inspect the downloaded sheet

claim: Payment happens on the hosted Sociobot checkout, not inside the product
sandbox: fresh real mode; assert no embedded checkout or payment script and follow the Sociobot checkout to its hosted merchant page

claim: A revoked license turns off the personal-note field
sandbox: fresh real mode with a recorded revoked verdict; assert the field remains disabled

claim: A browser license verdict is reused for less than 24 hours and refreshed at the boundary
sandbox: seed exact-token verdicts immediately below and above 86400000 ms; assert reuse and recheck behavior

claim: A license token is stored in this browser and sent to this site's license gateway in a request body when the app checks it
sandbox: fresh real mode; return a license token, record the check, and assert browser storage plus a same-origin POST body with no token in the URL

claim: The license gateway allows at most 20 checks per browser in 60 seconds
sandbox: shared rate-limit adapter; issue 21 sequential checks from one browser and assert the 21st is 429

claim: The license gateway does not cache verification responses
sandbox: recorded upstream verdict; assert the gateway response sends Cache-Control: no-store

claim: The license rate counter stores only a one-way browser digest, count, and expiry
sandbox: in-memory table adapter; perform a check and inspect the exact persisted fields and hashed key

claim: Core use loads no third-party fonts, scripts, analytics, or icon libraries
sandbox: fresh demo; record all runtime requests during creation and inspect loaded script and link elements

claim: The product artwork is original AI-generated artwork made for this product
sandbox: inspect the shipped source prompt record, model provenance, and exact 1200×630 derivative dimensions
